benchmark_train: run a benchmark of Detectron2 model training speed using a config file and 400 iterations
benchmark_eval: run a benchmark of Detectron2 model inference speed on 300 iterations with single GPU
benchmark_data: run a benchmark of the Detectron2 data loader performance with distributed testing across iterations
benchmark_data_advanced: run an advanced benchmark of the Detectron2 data loader analyzing dataset, mapper, workers, and IPC
setup_config: load and configure a Detectron2 config from a YAML or Python file with command-line overrides
